title: 2024 Emergency Response Guidebook (ERG)
description: The guide used in the first phase of a hazmat transportation incident. Free PDF in English, French, and Spanish, plus the ERG 2024 mobile app.

title: DOT Chart 17: Markings, Labeling, and Placarding Guide
description: The placard and label poster. Every DOT hazard class placard, the markings that go with them, and the label rules, on one sheet. Free PDF and app.

title: NIOSH Pocket Guide to Chemical Hazards
description: Exposure limits, IDLH values, physical properties, and protective-equipment notes for hundreds of chemicals. Searchable online and as a free app.

title: CAMEO Chemicals
description: Response and reactivity data for chemicals, with a reactivity predictor for mixtures. Free online and as an app.

title: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.120 (HAZWOPER)
description: The federal rule that sets the Awareness, Operations, and Technician responder levels and the training each one requires.

title: OSHA Hazard Communication pictograms
description: The nine GHS pictograms with the hazards each one stands for, as they appear on Safety Data Sheets and container labels.

title: NFPA free access to codes and standards
description: Read NFPA 470, 472, 1001, and 1010 online at no charge. Viewing needs a free NFPA account; the standards cannot be downloaded or printed.

title: Connecticut CFPC certification
description: The Commission on Fire Prevention and Control's certification page: exam applications, candidate information, and the standards each certification tests.
publisher: CT Commission on Fire Prevention and Control
